notes:
This is an early build, released to consoles set to Latest Updates.

The :8097 page's Debug tab has a new Tuning records section. It gives you
everything this console has stored from the tuners, complete and untrimmed: RAM
speed and timing runs, CPU undervolt, CPU frequency, GPU undervolt, every
session's step by step results, and the values those runs actually committed to
your boot entry.

It is its own download, separate from the diagnostic logs, so nothing about it
is shortened to fit. Send it with any report about a tuning result.

2.39.1 put a short summary of recent tuner sessions inside the diagnostic logs
instead. That has been removed in favor of this, so there is one place to look
and it holds everything.

stable.notes:
You can now choose whether this console takes every update or only stable ones.

Settings, Updates asks what you would like. Stable releases only is the default
and is what you have effectively been on until now. Latest Updates also takes
the builds released between stable ones, which carry new features first and are
more likely to have rough edges. You can change it whenever you like.

Wii U community packs now actually apply. Turning on a pack such as Resolution
or Shadow Resolution and choosing a value did nothing in game, and reopening the
menu could show the option named as an unreadable tag. The console was writing
your choice in a shape Cemu does not read, so the pack switched on with no value
behind it. Your existing choices are not lost: a pack that lost its value falls
back to its own default and sticks the next time you pick one.

On the Uploading tab, the Remove button on a parked upload can now be reached
with a controller. Press down from the tab bar to step onto it, and again to
confirm. Until now that button could only be pressed from the console's :8097
page in a browser.
